data.gender_notes: Fang is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Fang is derived from the Chinese word for bamboo. It symbolizes strength, resilience, and flexibility. In Chinese culture, bamboo is also associated with prosperity, growth, and good fortune. The name Fang carries the meaning “Bamboo” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Fang usually hope their child will grow to embody bamboo and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Fang total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
